title: Shapeless Paper Crafting
description: Craft paper with 3 sugar cane in any arrangement—no need for a specific pattern.
body:
This datapack lets you craft paper from any 3 sugar cane anywhere in either the 2×2 inventory grid or the 3×3 crafting grid—no shape needed!
